error.message: model_profile "local-unrestricted" is a name this contract's vocabulary still carries, but the loaded catalog no longer defines it - it was retired by a catalog pull request after this attempt was stamped. Re-plan: call /v1/route again against the catalog that is actually loaded. Note what this error is NOT: a name outside the contract vocabulary never reaches here, because PlaceRequest.model_profile is a closed enum and an unrecognised value is rejected 400 invalid_request at request validation. 404 is the catalog-moved case only.
